purpose: Stage and independently review only inert trusted pinned-root file-binding primitives for future Local Mistral conversion evidence verification.
requiredInvariants: This PR is inert and stages only binding of three fixed Local Mistral conversion artifacts beneath an already-open pinned trusted conversion-root directory FD; it does not discover or construct that root, parse conversion-report JSON, verify content digests, authorize model/server semantics, invoke a model, publish evidence/status, or activate a workflow.

Canonical conversion-root discovery and exact-main/run/attempt path authority are explicitly deferred to a later separately reviewed segment; this PR never opens '/' and never walks /srv/tai-models/conversion-runs.
The caller-provided root FD must be an integer open directory FD owned by root or the current effective service UID and must not be group- or world-writable.

Only compile-time literal child directories evidence, artifacts, toolchain and bin may be opened beneath the pinned root; every opened child directory uses O_DIRECTORY, O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC and must satisfy the same trusted owner/mode invariant.
The only admissible authority-relative strings are exact literals for conversion report, Mistral GGUF and llama-server; they are equality checks only and are never supplied as filesystem paths.
Final filenames are compile-time literals opened relative to already pinned trusted parent directory FDs with O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC.

Each final file is checked locally in the same binding function with fstat and must be a regular file owned by root or the current effective service UID with no group/world write permission before a pinned FD is returned.

Successful binding returns the same still-open pinned regular-file FD plus observed identity metadata; later pathname replacement cannot retarget that already-open FD. Callers must consume the returned FD rather than reopen a pathname.
All fail-closed ConversionEvidenceError raises suppress chained operating-system exception context and expose only fixed internal error codes.

Content hashing, sealed snapshots, conversion-root authority, conversion-report semantics, model identity and server binary identity are deliberately deferred to later separately reviewed segments and are not claimed by this PR.
No product, API, database, RBAC, registration, cabinet, customer-data or production-routing behavior is activated.
Local Qwen is the independent reviewer because this changes future Local Mistral authority only.
REG.RU remains production authority and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
